scientific_question: On untouched validation windows, is the small directed16 endpoint CE advantage over output32 distributed across the five replayed c_proj layers, concentrated in one or two layers, or functionally null despite the large trajectory and row-Gram recovery gain?

not_tested: new directed width, product, trust, or selector

all_common_requirements: checkpoint, terminal-state, endpoint-result, and dataset identities match exactly
all losses and derived gains are finite
only the five registered c_proj tensors differ between variants
each one-layer and cumulative variant uses the exact saved output32 or directed16 terminal tensor without fitting or interpolation
classification_rule.distributed_signal: directed16_all improves both fresh windows by at least 0.001 CE, at least four of five single-layer substitutions improve both windows, and the top two layers account for at most 75 percent of summed positive single-layer gain
classification_rule.layer_local_signal: directed16_all improves both fresh windows by at least 0.001 CE and the top two layers account for more than 75 percent of summed positive single-layer gain
classification_rule.functional_null: the all-layer gain is below 0.001 CE on either fresh window or changes sign
classification_rule.nonadditive_context: reported descriptively when the sum of mean single-layer gains differs from the mean all-layer gain by more than 50 percent of the larger magnitude

binding_next_actions.DISTRIBUTED_DIRECTED_FUNCTIONAL_SIGNAL: preregister a different high-mixing c_proj generator family; do not reuse directed-product supports or tune their capacity
binding_next_actions.LAYER_LOCAL_DIRECTED_FUNCTIONAL_SIGNAL: preregister one zero-update layer-targeting capacity test in the identified layers using a different generator family; no training
binding_next_actions.DIRECTED_ENDPOINT_FUNCTIONALLY_NULL: stop endpoint geometry fitting and return to the accepted temporal-error c_proj parent plus the c_fc/full-MLP cross-scale branch
binding_next_actions.NONADDITIVE_CPROJ_CONTEXT: measure coupled c_fc/c_proj or residual-frame action before selecting another tensor-local generator

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable to a zero-update fixed-checkpoint attribution
